en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਉਦਾ ਇਕਤੁ ਹਟਿ ਹੈ ਪੀਰਾਂ ਪੀਰੁ ਗੁਰਾਂ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: saudhaa ikat haT hai peeraa(n) peer guraa(n) gur pooraa|

en.bdb: Merchandise (of truth) is available only at that centre wherein sits the pit of the pits and the perfect Guru of the gurus.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਦੁਖ ਹਰਣੁ ਅਸਰਣੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਵਚਨ ਦਾ ਸੂਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: patit udhaaran dhukh haran asaran saran vachan dhaa sooraa|

en.bdb: He is saviour of the fallen, dispeller of sufferings, and shelter of the shelterless.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਉਗੁਣ ਲੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਕਣੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਵਿਸਰਾਇ ਵਿਸੂਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: aaugun lai gun vikanai sukh saagar visarai visooraa|

en.bdb: He takes away our demerits and bestows virtues.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਹਜਾਰ ਲਖ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: koT vikaar hajaar lakh paraupakaaree sadhaa hajooraa|

en.bdb: Instead, ocean of delights, the Lord makes us forget grief and disappointment.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਕਦਹੀ ਊਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: satinaam karataa purakh sat saroop na kadhahee uooraa|

en.bdb: He, the decimater of lacs of evils, is benevolent and ever present. He whose name is Truth, creator Lord, the truth form, never becomes incomplete i.e. He is ever complete.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚਖੰਡ ਵਸਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਾਏ ਤੂਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat sachakha(n)dd vas anahadh sabadh vajaae tooraa|

en.bdb: Residing in the holy congregation, the abode of truth,
He blows the trumpet of unstruck melody and shatters the sense of duality.
